description: A multi-factor investing strategy that computes momentum, volatility, and volume factors, ranks them using a simplified composite alpha score (simulating MLP factor combination), and holds the top-k equal-weighted securities with drop-n turnover control and trailing stop risk management.
risk_controls: Trailing stop loss at 15% from peak price
Drop-n turnover control limiting daily rebalance sells to bottom 5 ranked current holdings
T+1 settlement model enforced via DelayedSettlementModel

data_requirements.reason: Used for momentum calculation, Bollinger Band width, and composite alpha ranking
Used for volume ratio factor in composite alpha calculation
